'''Star Tours Flight 310''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight that traveled to [[Storinal]] and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at Gate 1L, and its status was on time with an estimated time of arrival at the spaceport at 1045. It was scheduled to depart again at 1140.
